questions.def: Past perfect indicates action completed before another past action.
questions.question: By the time he arrived, the concert ___ already begun.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous emphasizes duration of action before another past action.
questions.question: She ___ the letter before he arrived.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous for an action continuing until another past action.
questions.question: I ___ for him for hours when he finally arrived.

questions.def: Reported speech: past perfect for actions before the reporting time.
questions.question: He said he ___ visited Paris the year before.

questions.def: Future in the past: what was expected to happen at a future time.
questions.question: They ___ the project by the deadline.

questions.def: Past perfect for completed action before another action in the past.
questions.question: He ___ in that house for five years before he moved.

questions.def: Past continuous describes ongoing action interrupted by another action.
questions.question: She ___ about the incident when I interrupted her.

questions.def: Past perfect indicates the promise was made before a later action.
questions.question: He ___ that he would arrive on time.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous emphasizes duration before a specific time in the past.
questions.question: They ___ all night for the exam.

questions.def: 'Was going to' indicates an intention that was not fulfilled.
questions.question: I ___ to call you earlier, but I got busy.

questions.def: 'Was supposed to' implies an expectation not necessarily met.
questions.question: She ___ to finish the project by yesterday.

questions.def: Past perfect simple to show the action was completed before another past action.
questions.question: They ___ all the cake before the guests arrived.

questions.def: 'Would' is the past tense form of 'will' in reported speech.
questions.question: He told me he ___ call me back later.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous describes an action continuing until a later past point.
questions.question: They ___ planning the event for weeks.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous: ongoing action during all of yesterday.
questions.question: It ___ all day yesterday.

questions.def: Past perfect: action completed before a specific time in the past.
questions.question: By 9 PM, everyone ___ already gone home.

questions.def: 'Was expected' expresses a past expectation not always fulfilled.
questions.question: She ___ to have finished the report by now.

questions.def: 'Were planning' shows an intention that was not yet certain.
questions.question: They ___ to visit Italy next summer.

questions.def: Past perfect tense indicates completion before another past action.
questions.question: Before I knew it, the movie ___ already started.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous emphasizes the duration of thinking.
questions.question: He ___ about what happened.

questions.def: 'Is' should be 'was' to align with 'ago' (past).
questions.question: She is supposed to have arrived an hour ago.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous: activity continued for years until publication.
questions.question: She ___ the novel for years before it was published.

questions.def: Past perfect shows play started before we found seats.
questions.question: The play ___ begun by the time we found our seats.

questions.def: 'Was intending' express a past intention that was not realised.
questions.question: I ___ to go to the concert, but I got sick.

questions.def: Past perfect 'had fled' shows the action finished before another past action.
questions.question: By the time the police arrived, the thief ___.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous shows an action continuing up to a past point.
questions.question: She ___ writing her novel for five years before it was published.

questions.def: Future perfect shows an action completed before a future point in time.
questions.question: By 2025, they ___ in London for twenty years.

questions.def: Past perfect 'hadn't expected' shows surprise at a past event.
questions.question: I ___ expected him to call so late.

questions.def: Past perfect 'had known' indicates prior state before another past action.
questions.question: She ___ about the issue until I mentioned it.

questions.def: Past continuous 'was waiting' shows an action in progress at a time.
questions.question: He ___ for her call all day yesterday.
